tasks.title: Przedstaw się
tasks.instruction: Powiedz na głos 4 zdania o sobie: imię, skąd jesteś, gdzie mieszkasz i co robisz w wolnym czasie.
tasks.example: Hi, I'm Domin. I'm from Poland. I live in Szczecin, near the German border. In my free time, I go to the gym and listen to techno.

tasks.title: Plany na weekend
tasks.instruction: Powiedz 3 zdania o swoich planach na najbliższy weekend. Użyj „going to” i „I'm …-ing”.
tasks.example: This weekend I'm going to sleep a lot. On Saturday I'm meeting some friends in the city centre. On Sunday I want to go to the gym and chill at home.

tasks.title: Twój zwykły dzień
tasks.instruction: Opowiedz w 4 zdaniach, jak wygląda twój zwykły dzień roboczy. Same nawyki — Present Simple.
tasks.example: I usually get up at half past five. I start work at seven. After work, I go to the gym. In the evening, I play games or listen to music.

tasks.title: Zagadaj o pogodzie
tasks.instruction: Czekasz na tramwaj obok kogoś z Anglii. Zagadaj o pogodzie, zapytaj o weekend i odpowiedz na to samo pytanie.
tasks.example: Nice weather today, isn't it? Finally some sun! How was your weekend? Mine was pretty good, thanks. I went to a party with some friends.

tasks.title: Twoje miasto
tasks.instruction: Opowiedz o Szczecinie w 4 zdaniach. Użyj „there is” i „there are”.
tasks.example: Szczecin is a port city in the north-west of Poland. There are a lot of parks and old buildings. There's a big river and a cool club scene. There aren't many tourists, so it's pretty quiet.

tasks.title: Zabrakło słowa
tasks.instruction: Opisz po angielsku 3 rzeczy, jakbyś nie znał ich nazw: otwieracz do butelek, ładowarkę do telefonu i zakwasy.
tasks.example: It's a thing for opening bottles. It's a kind of cable for your phone. It's like pain in your muscles, but it's good — you get it after the gym.

tasks.title: Umów się na trening
tasks.instruction: Zaproś kumpla na wspólny trening: zapytaj, czy ma czas, zaproponuj dzień, godzinę i miejsce.
tasks.example: Hey, are you free on Thursday? Let's go to the gym together. Let's meet at six in front of the gym. Does six work for you?

tasks.title: W barze
tasks.instruction: Zamów dwa napoje, zapytaj o cenę, czy możesz zapłacić kartą, i podziękuj.
tasks.example: Hi, can I have two beers, please? How much is it? Can I pay by card? Great, thanks a lot!

tasks.title: Szczecin dla obcokrajowca
tasks.instruction: Ktoś z Anglii nigdy nie słyszał o Szczecinie. Wyjaśnij w 4–5 zdaniach: gdzie leży, jak daleko od Berlina, z czego słynie i co tam jest.
starters: It's in the north-west of Poland…
tasks.example: Szczecin is in the north-west of Poland, right next to Germany. It's about two hours from Berlin. It's famous for its port and the river. There are lots of parks and some really good clubs.

tasks.title: Twoja praca
tasks.instruction: Opowiedz o swojej pracy: gdzie pracujesz, o której zaczynasz, co robisz i co lubisz albo czego nie lubisz.
starters: The best thing about my job is…
tasks.example: I work in a warehouse. I start at six in the morning. I'm responsible for checking deliveries. It's hard work, but the best thing about my job is the people.

tasks.title: Twoja rodzina
tasks.instruction: Opowiedz o 2–3 osobach z rodziny. Pilnuj trzeciej osoby: he works, she lives, my dad has.
tasks.example: I've got one older brother. He works as a mechanic and he has two kids. My parents live in a small town near Szczecin. I visit them once a month.

tasks.title: Twoje mieszkanie
tasks.instruction: Opisz swoje mieszkanie i okolicę. Użyj co najmniej dwa razy „there is” i dwa razy „there are”.
tasks.example: I live in a small flat on the fourth floor. There's a big TV and a small balcony. There are two rooms and a kitchen. There isn't a lift, so it's good exercise!

tasks.title: Twój dzień
tasks.instruction: Opowiedz, jak wygląda twój dzień od budzika do snu. Użyj: always, usually, sometimes, never.
tasks.example: My alarm goes off at five. I always have a quick breakfast and take the tram to work. After work, I usually go to the gym. I sometimes play games, but I never go to bed after midnight on weekdays.

tasks.title: Plany zawodowe
tasks.instruction: Powiedz, co chcesz robić zawodowo za rok i za pięć lat. Użyj „I'd like to” i „I'm going to”.
starters: In five years, I want to…
tasks.example: I'd like to change jobs. Next year I'm going to do a course and get a forklift licence. In five years, I want to have my own flat and maybe work abroad.

tasks.title: Twój trening
tasks.instruction: Opowiedz o swoim treningu: ile razy w tygodniu, jaki masz podział, co dziś robisz i jaki masz rekord.
tasks.example: I train five times a week, usually after work. My split is push, pull, legs. Today I'm doing legs, so I'm a bit scared! My max on bench is a hundred kilos.

tasks.title: Twoja muzyka
tasks.instruction: Opowiedz o swoim guście muzycznym: co lubisz, czego nie lubisz, kogo widziałeś na żywo i kogo chcesz zobaczyć.
starters: I'm not a big fan of…
tasks.example: I'm really into techno, especially the darker stuff. I'm not a big fan of commercial EDM. I've seen Amelie Lens live twice. I can't wait to see Charlotte de Witte this summer.

tasks.title: Dlaczego festiwale?
tasks.instruction: Wytłumacz komuś, kto nigdy nie był na festiwalu, dlaczego co roku jeździsz na Tomorrowland.
tasks.example: Every year I go to Tomorrowland in Belgium. The atmosphere is unreal. There are sixteen stages and amazing DJs. You meet people from all over the world, and everyone is happy.

tasks.title: Twoje gry
tasks.instruction: Opowiedz, w co grasz, na czym, z kim i dlaczego to lubisz.
tasks.example: I mostly play on PC. At the moment I'm playing CS and Elden Ring. I usually play CS with my friends from work. I play to relax after a long day.

tasks.title: Zaproś kumpla
tasks.instruction: Zaproś kogoś na weekend: zaproponuj dwie opcje, zapytaj, co woli, i ustal godzinę.
tasks.example: Do you fancy doing something this weekend? How about the cinema on Saturday? Or we could go to the lake on Sunday. What would you rather do? Let's say six o'clock?

tasks.title: Idealny weekend
tasks.instruction: Opisz swój idealny weekend od piątku wieczorem do niedzieli.
tasks.example: On Friday night I go out with my friends — maybe a club. On Saturday I sleep in, then I go to the gym. In the evening I play games. On Sunday I need a lazy day: Netflix and pizza.
